from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import os
import re
import stat

path = Path('settings.py')
before = path.read_bytes()
mode = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)
before_sha = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
pattern = rb'(?m)"'^(?P<prefix>[ '"\\t]*retry_budget[ \\t]*=[ \\t]*)(?P<value>[0-9]+)(?P<suffix>[ \\t]*(?:#["'^'"\\r\\n]*)?\\r?"'$)'"'
matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, before))
if len(matches) "'!= 1:
    raise ValueError('"'Expected exactly one retry_budget assignment')
match = matches[0]
budget = int(match.group('value')) + 3
timeout_pattern = rb'(?m)"'^[ '"\\t]*timeout[ \\t]*=[ \\t]*(?P<value>[0-9]+)[ \\t]*(?:#["'^'"\\r\\n]*)?\\r?"'$'"'
timeouts = list(re.finditer(timeout_pattern, before))
if len(timeouts) "'!= 1 or int(timeouts[0].group('"'value')) "'!= 30:
    raise ValueError('"'Expected timeout=30')
start, end = match.span('value')
after_expected = before[:start] + str(budget).encode('ascii') + before[end:]
with path.open('r+b') as file:
    file.write(after_expected)
    file.truncate()
after = path.read_bytes()
after_mode = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)
new_matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, after))
new_timeouts = list(re.finditer(timeout_pattern, after))
unrelated_preserved = after == after_expected and after_mode == mode
verified = (unrelated_preserved and len(new_matches) == 1 and int(new_matches[0].group('value')) == budget and len(new_timeouts) == 1 and int(new_timeouts[0].group('value')) == 30)
import json
print(json.dumps({'path': str(path), 'before_sha256': before_sha, 'after_sha256': hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest(), 'retry_budget': budget, 'timeout': int(new_timeouts[0].group('value')), 'verified': verified, 'unrelated_preserved': unrelated_preserved}))
if not verified:
    raise ValueError('Verification failed')
PY"

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import re
import stat

path = Path('settings.py')
before = path.read_bytes()
mode = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)
before_sha = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
pattern = rb'(?m)"'^[ '"\\t]*retry_budget[ \\t]*=[ \\t]*([0-9]+)(?=[ \\t]*(?:#["'^'"\\r\\n]*)?\\r?"'$)'"'
matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, before))
if len(matches) "'!= 1:
    raise RuntimeError('"'Expected exactly one retry_budget assignment')
match = matches[0]
timeout_pattern = rb'(?m)"'^[ '"\\t]*timeout[ \\t]*=[ \\t]*([0-9]+)(?=[ \\t]*(?:#["'^'"\\r\\n]*)?\\r?"'$)'"'
timeouts = list(re.finditer(timeout_pattern, before))
if len(timeouts) "'!= 1 or int(timeouts[0].group(1)) != 30:
    raise RuntimeError('"'Expected timeout=30')
budget = int(match.group(1)) + 3
start, end = match.span(1)
replacement = str(budget).encode('ascii')
expected = before[:start] + replacement + before[end:]
with path.open('r+b') as file:
    file.write(expected)
    file.truncate()
after = path.read_bytes()
after_mode = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)
after_matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, after))
after_timeouts = list(re.finditer(timeout_pattern, after))
verified = after == expected and len(after_matches) == 1 and int(after_matches[0].group(1)) == budget and len(after_timeouts) == 1 and int(after_timeouts[0].group(1)) == 30
unrelated_preserved = after[:start] == before[:start] and after[start + len(replacement):] == before[end:] and after_mode == mode
if not verified or not unrelated_preserved:
    raise RuntimeError('Verification failed')
import json
print(json.dumps({'path': str(path), 'before_sha256': before_sha, 'after_sha256': hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest(), 'retry_budget': budget, 'timeout': 30, 'verified': verified, 'unrelated_preserved': unrelated_preserved}))
PY"
